description: Fee records with a fee rate of exactly 0.0009 are included along with those above it.

a.request: Take fee records with a fee rate (`feerate`) of at least 0.0009 and match each to its order (`fees.orderslink` = `orders.recordvault`, exact text match; drop fees with no matching order). For each combination of `orderslink` and trading pair (`mktnote`), show `orderslink`, the trading pair, the average maker rebate rate (`rebrate`), and the total rebate (the sum of `rebtotal`), ignoring missing values. Sort by total rebate from highest to lowest (missing last), keep the top 10, and don't round.
a.sql: SELECT f.orderslink, o.mktnote, AVG(f.rebrate) as avg_rebrate, SUM(f.rebtotal) as total_rebate FROM fees f INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault WHERE f.feerate >= 0.0009 GROUP BY f.orderslink, o.mktnote ORDER BY total_rebate DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

d.request: Filter fees where feerate >= 0.0009 (inclusive), join to orders on exact orderslink = recordvault match, exclude unmatched fees, group by orderslink and mktnote to show orderslink, trading pair, average rebrate, and sum of rebtotal (excluding nulls), sort by total rebate descending with nulls last, return top 10, and preserve full precision without rounding.
d.sql: SELECT f.orderslink, o.mktnote, AVG(f.rebrate) as average_rebrate, SUM(f.rebtotal) as total_rebate FROM fees f INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault WHERE f.feerate >= 0.0009 GROUP BY f.orderslink, o.mktnote ORDER BY total_rebate DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10

b.request: Fee records where feerate is greater than or equal to 0.0009, matched to orders by exact text match on orderslink and recordvault with fees having no matching order excluded, grouped by orderslink and mktnote to display orderslink, trading pair, average rebrate, and sum of rebtotal excluding null values, sorted descending by total rebate with nulls last, limited to top 10 results without rounding.
b.sql: SELECT f.orderslink, o.mktnote, AVG(f.rebrate) as average_rebrate, SUM(f.rebtotal) as total_rebate FROM fees f INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault WHERE f.feerate >= 0.0009 GROUP BY f.orderslink, o.mktnote ORDER BY total_rebate DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
b.raw: Fee records where feerate is greater than or equal to 0.0009, matched to orders by exact text match on orderslink and recordvault with fees having no matching order excluded, grouped by orderslink and mktnote to display orderslink, trading pair, average rebrate, and sum of rebtotal excluding null values, sorted descending by total rebate with nulls last, limited to top 10 results without rounding.

c.request: Using only high-rate fee records, with 0.0009 on the fee rate (`feerate`) as the cutoff, match each fee to its order (`fees.orderslink` = `orders.recordvault`, exact text match; drop fees with no matching order). For each combination of `orderslink` and trading pair (`mktnote`), show `orderslink`, the trading pair, the average maker rebate rate (`rebrate`), and the total rebate (the sum of `rebtotal`), ignoring missing values. Sort by total rebate from highest to lowest (missing last), keep the top 10, and don't round. Fee records with a fee rate of exactly 0.0009 are included along with those above it.
c.sql: SELECT f.orderslink, o.mktnote, AVG(f.rebrate) as avg_rebate, SUM(f.rebtotal) as total_rebate FROM fees f INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault WHERE f.feerate >= 0.0009 GROUP BY f.orderslink, o.mktnote ORDER BY CASE WHEN SUM(f.rebtotal) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, SUM(f.rebtotal) DESC LIMIT 10
